p. p. [जि-कर्मणि क्त] 
__1 Conquered, subdued, curbed, restrained, (as enemies, passions &c.). 
__2 Won, got, obtained (by conquest). 
__3 Surpassed, excelled. 4 Subject to, enslaved or influenced by; कामजित; स्त्रीजित &c. 
-तम् Victory. 
-Comp. 
-अक्षर a. reading well or readily. 
-अमित्र a. one who has conquered his foes, triumphant, victorious. 
__2 one who has subdued his passions. 
(-त्रः) N. of Viṣṇu. 
-अरि a. one who has conquered his enemies or passions. 
(-रिः) an epithet of Buddha. 
-आत्मन् a. self-subdued, void of passion; जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य [[

.]] 
-आहव a. victorious. 
-इन्द्रिय a. one who has conquered his passions or subdued the senses (रूप, रस, गन्ध, स्पर्श & शब्द); श्रुत्वा स्पृष्ट्वाऽथ दृष्ट्वा च भुक्त्वा घ्रात्वा च यो नरः । न हृष्यति ग्लायति वा स विज्ञेयो जितेन्द्रियः [[

.]] 
-काशिः the fist doubled. 
-काशिन् a. appearing victorious, proud of victory, assuming the airs of a victor; जितकाशिनश्च खचराः [[
]]; भीष्मः पुरुषमानी च जितकाशी तथैव च ibid. 5. 177. 12; चाणक्योऽपि जितकाशितया [[
Mu. 2

]]; जितकाशी राजसेवकः ibid. 
-कोप, -क्रोध, -मन्यु a. imperturbable, not excitable. 
(-धः) an epithet of Viṣṇu. 
-नेमिः a staff made of the Aśvattha tree. 
-लोक a. ‘one who has won heaven’ (epithet of a class of manes). 
-शत्रु a. victorious. 
-शिश्नोदर a. One who has overcome lust and appetite. 
-श्रम a. inured to fatigue, hardy; कृतहस्तो जितश्रमः [[

.]] 
-स्वर्ग n. one who has won heaven. 
-हस्त a. one who has exercised his hand.

a. 
__1 Oppressed, overpowered. 
__2 Become old; also जीन.
a. [जि-क्विप्] (At the end of comp.) Conquering, defeating, winning &c.; तारकजित्, कंसजित्, सहस्रजित् &c.

f. 
__1 Victory, conquest; क्षेमाय तापविरमाय च मृत्युजित्यै [[

.]] 
__2 Gaining, obtaining; सिषासनिर्बनते कार इज्जितिम् [[

f. [जि-क्तिन् वेदे दीर्घः] 
__1 Victory. 
__2 Decrease, loss. 
__3 Fading away, growing old.

a. Conquerable. 
-त्या 
__1 Victory. 
__2 Acquisition, gain. 
__3 A ploughshare. 
-त्यः A harrow.
a. Victorious.

a. [जि-क्वरप्] 
(-री f.) Victorious, conquering, triumphant; शस्त्राण्युपायंसत जित्वराणि [[
]]; करदीकृतभूपालो भ्रातृभिर्जित्वरैर्दिशाम् [[Śi. 2. 9]]; अपि विष्टपजित्वरेषुणा तनुनाहारि शिवस्य नो मनः [[Śiva

.]] 
-री N. of the Benares city.

जित्तमः,
जितुमः, जित्मः Gemini, the third sign of the zodiac (a word of Greek origin); [[Bṛhajjātaka 1. 8]]; 24. 14.
An instrument for levelling or smoothing ploughed ground. (Mar. कुळव).
